title: finance
subHeroTitle: All your business finances, managed in one workspace.
subHeroDesc: KeilHQ handles invoicing, expense tracking, bank reconciliation, and payroll — so your team spends less time on financial admin and more time on the work that matters.

sections.title: Track every dollar, across every part of your business
sections.desc: Log revenue, expenses, transfers, and taxes — organized by category, project, department, or team. Works across multiple currencies and multiple business entities.

gridItems.title: Full transaction ledger
gridItems.desc: Log and categorize every financial transaction — revenue, expenses, taxes, refunds, transfers, and more.

gridItems.title: Multiple books
gridItems.desc: Run separate books for different subsidiaries or business units — all managed from the same workspace.

gridItems.title: Multi-currency
gridItems.desc: Log transactions and generate reports in any currency — INR, USD, EUR, GBP, or whatever your business uses.

gridItems.title: Tag by project or department
gridItems.desc: Attach every transaction to a category, vendor, project, or department so you can analyze spending any way you need.

sections.title: Create invoices and get paid, without the back-and-forth
sections.desc: Build professional invoices with automatic tax and discount calculations, send them directly to clients by email, and share a payment link so they can settle instantly.

gridItems.title: Invoice builder
gridItems.desc: Add line items, quantities, prices, taxes, and discounts — totals calculate automatically.

gridItems.title: Recurring billing
gridItems.desc: Set up invoices to send automatically on a weekly, monthly, or quarterly schedule for subscription clients.

gridItems.title: PDF generation and email
gridItems.desc: Download a professional invoice PDF or send it directly to your client with a custom message — straight from KeilHQ.

gridItems.title: Payment collection links
gridItems.desc: Share a secure link so clients can pay online. The ledger updates automatically when they do.

sections.title: Know exactly what's in your bank accounts at all times
sections.desc: Track all your bank accounts, credit cards, and wallets in one dashboard. Import bank statements and KeilHQ matches the transactions to your records automatically.

gridItems.title: All accounts in one place
gridItems.desc: See live balances across every bank account, credit card, cash register, and digital wallet your business uses.

gridItems.title: Internal fund transfers
gridItems.desc: Record transfers between your own accounts with reference numbers and notes — so nothing looks unaccounted for.

gridItems.title: Bank statement import
gridItems.desc: Upload your bank statement and KeilHQ ingests all the transactions automatically — no manual entry required.

gridItems.title: Automatic reconciliation
gridItems.desc: KeilHQ matches imported bank transactions against your ledger entries automatically, flagging any discrepancies.

sections.title: Run payroll and understand your financial health
sections.desc: Process monthly salaries with tax deductions calculated automatically, generate payslips for each employee, and get a clear view of your business's financial position through 11 built-in reports.

gridItems.title: Automated payroll
gridItems.desc: Calculate gross pay, tax deductions, reimbursements, and net salary for every employee in one automated run.

gridItems.title: Digital payslips
gridItems.desc: Generate and download official monthly payslips for every employee — ready to share or file.

gridItems.title: 11 financial reports
gridItems.desc: Track profit & loss, cash flow, revenue, expenses, and vendor spend with reports that update in real time.

gridItems.title: Runway estimator
gridItems.desc: See how long your current cash lasts at your current burn rate — so you can make informed decisions before it becomes urgent.

capabilitiesTitle: Complete financial control, built into your workspace.
capabilitiesDesc: Invoicing, expense tracking, bank reconciliation, payroll, and financial reporting — all in the same place as your team's work.
checklistDesc: KeilHQ handles the financial tasks your team spends too much time on — so you can focus on actually running the business.
checklistItems: Track every transaction across multiple accounts, books, and currencies — organized by project, department, or vendor.
Create and send professional invoices in minutes, with taxes calculated automatically and a payment link included.
Set up recurring invoices for subscription clients so billing runs automatically every month without manual effort.
Import your bank statement and KeilHQ reconciles it against your records automatically — no manual matching.
Run monthly payroll with tax deductions calculated and payslips generated in one workflow.
Get a clear view of profit, cash flow, and runway so you always know where your business stands financially.
